svg.aria-label: Scan rotation: the center of mass of the direct beam over the scan is a gradient field in the scan frame. In the detector frame it is rotated and has curl; rotating the detector axes until the curl vanishes gives the angle, which is ambiguous by 180 degrees
svg.font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
